snippet.title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole? 🕳️
snippet.description:
A calm, first-person trip into a supermassive black hole. 🕳️ Stylized animation, simplified physics.

FACT CHECK
• Black holes, event horizons and why not even light escapes: NASA https://science.nasa.gov/universe/black-holes/
• Sagittarius A*, the black hole at the center of our galaxy, is about 4 million times the mass of the Sun: Event Horizon Telescope https://eventhorizontelescope.org/blog/astronomers-reveal-first-image-black-hole-heart-our-galaxy
• Light bends around a black hole (gravitational lensing) and very close in it can loop all the way around: NASA https://science.nasa.gov/universe/black-holes/
• Near a black hole your clock runs slow compared with clocks far away (gravitational time dilation). For a black hole this big, crossing the event horizon would feel like nothing at all.
